About the author

Karl Deisseroth is a professor of bioengineering and psychiatry at Stanford University. The winner of the Kyoto Prize and the Heineken Prize, Deisseroth has five children, directs Stanford's undergraduate degree in bioengineering, and treats patients with mood disorders and autism.
